nodes.label: GPI
props: Autocrine motility factor; D-hexose-6-phosphate anomerase; Glucose-6-phosphate C2-epimerase; Neuroleukin; Phosphoglucose isomerase; Phosphohexose isomerase; Sperm antigen 36

Isomerase that catalyzes the conversion of alpha-D-glucose-6-phosphate to beta-D-fructose-6-phosphate, the second step in glycolysis, and the reverse reaction in gluconeogenesis, within the cytoplasm. Also shows C2-epimerase activity, interconverting D-glucose-6-phosphate (G6P) and D-mannose-6-phosphate (M6P).

props: A D-fructofuranose 1,6-bisphosphate(4−) that is the conjugate base of β-D-fructofuranose 1,6-bisphosphate.

Catalyzes the hydrolysis of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate to fructose 6-phosphate in the presence of divalent cations, acting as a rate-limiting enzyme in gluconeogenesis. Plays a role in regulating glucose sensing and insulin secretion of pancreatic beta-cells.
